description: This Java interface defines a client for accessing Hono's Registration API, including methods for asserting device registration and registration status with optional gateway and tracing context.

classes.name: RegistrationClient
classes.description: An interface representing a client for Hono's device registration API, providing methods to assert registration status of devices.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Asserts that a device is registered and enabled, returning a Future with the registration status. Overloaded methods support specifying a gateway ID and tracing context.

calls: assertRegistration(String deviceId, String gatewayId, SpanContext context)
